short: First neural transducer for audio-visual speech in the ledger, but the LRS3 gain mixes 31k h of data, external-LM baselines and the decoder; one run, one test set: all changes standard.
position: M06, M02 and M03 changed, all standard: RNN-T is new in the ledger (0 of 123 earlier sentence-level studies) and RNN-T decoders still hold 0.9% LRS3 AVSR WER, but the paper never compares it with CTC or attention on its own 31k-hour corpus; the corpus scales the V2P pipeline; competing-speech training extends GRID-era work to large-vocabulary end-to-end training on one run and one non-public test set. The LRS3 state-of-the-art claim confounds data volume, the decoder and the comparators' external LM, as the authors partly concede.
